result: fixed front-three-quarter preset, overflow-safe interpolation and zoom, bounded height inputs, and explicit terrain sample failure; narrowed claims to provisional helper scope
findings: closeInspectionPreset previously used heading + 0.75*pi, which computes behind the animal under the +Z-forward and (sin(azimuth), cos(azimuth)) convention; changed to +0.25*pi and tested positive forward dot product.
interpolateScalar previously formed current-target and overflowed for opposite extreme finite values; changed to weighted blend and tested DBL_MAX endpoints.
interpolateAngle now normalizes both finite inputs before subtraction, avoiding subtraction overflow; tested opposite extreme finite angles.
Target height and terrain clearance now have documented provisional bounds [0,20]m and [0,10]m and reject negatives/out-of-range values.
Non-finite or out-of-bounds terrain callback heights now fail explicitly instead of silently skipping the clearance claim.
Zoom rejects overflow in wheelDelta*zoomSpeed before clamping.
